tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: 1st Year Maintenance of Grassland at MM Road Burning Place Area Near Hebballa Bridge 45.0 Ha in Antharasanthe WL Range During 2026-27

itemList.description: Clearance of weed growth of eupatorium and thorny bushes in open gaps cutting stumps of saplings flush to the ground singling of copiece shoots cutting of woody climbers carrying and heaping the debris at places where planting is not necessary for raising plantations in areas where the canopy cover is between 0.4 to 0.6 (burning and re-burning operations not to be done) KFD SSR Item No 21 (f)

Planting of khus grass or local Availble suitable grass on bunds with the following items of works. Transportation of Khus grass to planting site after uprooting the same from the nursery beds KFD SSR Item No 129 (c) (Rate 74.9/1000 Slips) Calculation (5,36,000 Slips * 74.9/1000 Slips = 40,146/-)
Planting of Khus grass slips in plantations area at suitable spacing all along the contour of the bed and gullies. KFD SSR Item No 129 (d) Calcuation (5,36,000 Slips * 792.84/1000 Slips = 4,24,962/-)

Clear weeding by cutting all weeds flush to the ground retaining seedlings of important species, not directly interfering with the main crop in areas with heavy weed growth of Euphatorim, solanum etc. First weeding. KFD SSR Item No 29(g)(i)
Miscellaneous item like collection of locally available palatable grass seeds, purchasing of implements, documentation and plantation name board, etc.
